purpose: Recheck the real facing-chair-backs trace after preserving the intrinsic orientation condition.
selection: Only the affected original NR3D utterance; no target or stimulus IDs enter inference. Preserve the unsupported intrinsic facing condition even when observer origin is also missing.
runtime_input: Original query plus full prepared scene and annotated object table; target and stimulus IDs are evaluation only.

rows.query: Facing the back of the chairs, the chair on the left.
rows.acceptance_focus: Record chair-back orientation as an independent missing condition; plural facing must not imply a known intrinsic orientation or invent an observer origin.
